collection_order: seed offset, population in listed order, sigma in listed order; complete all nine rows per offset
budget_rule: Before next nine-row block, stop if elapsed plus 1.5 times slowest completed block exceeds budget. No outcome-based stopping. Finish complete 240-prompt rows and balanced population/sigma blocks. Fewer than 306 candidates is insufficient evidence.
tie_rule: descending observed mean, then ascending SHA256(rank-tie-v1:<candidate_id>), fixed independently of rewards; same rule for full reference
random_order_generator: numpy.default_rng(seed).permutation(200); nested subsets within each order

phase4_signal_gate.scope: development random orders only; at least one budget meets both

bound_semantics: Hoeffding uses a union bound over candidates and stages, random without-replacement order, no finite-population tightening. Wilson racing is an exploratory pointwise heuristic, not an anytime confidence guarantee. Both become exact at 200 prompts; eliminate only upper < kth-largest active lower.
policy_output_ranking: survivors sorted by final observed mean; discarded groups in reverse elimination order, each sorted by its last mean. Correlations use last observed means and separately report unequal sample counts.
development_selection: Only random-order policies eligible. Qualify if joint gate succeeds on >=90% development orders; choose lowest mean pair cost, then highest mean top10 recall, lowest mean regret, lexicographic policy ID. If none qualifies, lock a diagnostic policy among mean-cost<=40% by highest joint success, recall, then lowest regret and cost. No validation-driven reselection.
holdout_rule: develop command reads development candidate rows only; save and commit policy-lock.json before validation command can load validation rows. Validation policy and gate never retuned. Remaining baseline validation tables are descriptive.
uncertainty: Random-order repetitions measure conditional prompt-subset sensitivity. Shared prompts and paired sigmas/seeds are dependent; no iid candidate or pair claims. Full means refer to this finite frozen benchmark, not population accuracy.
ensemble: After policy lock, majority vote extracted upstream answers on 40 disjoint test prompts; omit empty answers; Counter.most_common insertion-order tie behavior following candidate ranking. No test rewards used for policy selection. Token budget savings concern selection200 only, not ensemble test cost.
specialists: Descriptive unique/rare correctness (<=10% population solves), original-order last-quartile signals, and partial misses of full top10. No inferred semantic skill labels.
trajectory_plot: fixed development order seed100; full-score top/middle/bottom three, early4 leaders outside full top20, full top10 outside early32 top50; deterministic selection without validation tuning
